onboarding.title: Set up {project}
onboarding.lead: Studio runs inside the project it was launched in. Check the chat agent, add the model keys your workflows need, then open a workflow.

agent.title: Chat agent
agent.description: The chat runs the agent on this computer with your own subscription. Studio never reads or stores your credentials.
agent.backendLoadFailed: Could not load the selected agent
agent.checkFailed: The sign-in could not be checked.
agent.selectHint: New threads use this agent. Existing Claude and Codex threads stay in this project.
agent.signedOut: Not signed in to {backend}. Run this in a terminal, then check again:
agent.unknown: Could not tell whether {backend} is signed in.

keys.title: Model keys
keys.description: Your workflows call models through these providers.
keys.missingNote: No model key is set yet. Add one so your workflows can call a model.
keys.loadError: Model keys could not be loaded.
keys.shellNote: {variable} is set in the shell that started Studio. Change it there.
keys.shadowNote: The value saved in .env is not used while the shell sets {variable}.

rejected.SECRET_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED: Keys are saved only in the .env file of this project.
rejected.NOT_A_SECRET_KEY: This setting has no environment variable, so it cannot hold a key.
rejected.SECRET_KEY_NEEDS_SECRET: This setting holds a key, not a plain value.
rejected.SECRET_VALUE_INVALID: The key has a line break in it. Paste it again as one line.

secrets.title: Other secrets
secrets.description: Tools and MCP servers of this project read these secrets.

workflow.title: Workflows
workflow.description: Open one to keep working on it.
workflow.emptyHint: A workflow is a flow.yaml file under the flows folder of this project. Ask the chat agent to draft the first one.

agent.title: Your coding agent
agent.description: Projects made with aqven new include .mcp.json, so Claude Code started in the project folder connects on its own.
agent.claudeCode: Claude Code started in another folder
agent.claudeCodeHint: Run this once in that folder.
agent.otherClients: Cursor, Claude Desktop and other clients
agent.otherClientsHint: Add this server to the MCP config of the client.

chat.title: Studio chat
chat.description: The chat panel runs Claude Code or Codex on this computer with your own sign-in. Studio never reads or stores your credentials.

about.title: About
about.updateHint: Run this in the project folder, then restart Studio.
